# Raid DPS rankings by gear tier

> Generated by `_reference/data/raidsim/ml_builds.py` on 2026-11-19 from the machine-learning pipeline's records (`_reference/data/raidsim/ml/`). Do not hand-edit.

Every raid damage spec's DPS in three gear tiers: **Quests and dungeons** (quest rewards, 5-player dungeon boss drops, trainer recipes and reputation up to Honored: no rare recipe, no Upper Blackrock Spire, no Tier 0.5), **Pre-BiS** (everything Forever has now outside raids: dungeons, crafted, quests, world drops and reputation; no Tier 0.5) and **Raid BiS** (adds Molten Core and Onyxia (the raids open on 2026-12-09)). Items the game holds back for a later phase are in none of them (the simulator's database dates every item). Each spec gets its own set per tier (raidsim/gear_tiers.py: the simulator's stat weights for the spec, the best item per slot, set pieces and trinket pairs raced). Its talents are searched separately for the Pre-BiS and Raid BiS tiers and each setting (raidsim/ml_talents.py: a random forest trained on simulated builds guides a genetic search over every legal build of the spec; the finalists are raced on fresh seeds and the winner is checked against every one-move and prerequisite-chain neighbour); the quests-and-dungeons tier races those winners in its own set (raidsim/dungeon_tier.py). *Full raid*: every raid buff and debuff. 3-minute fights; each number is the winner's average over 100,000 fights (standard error about ±0.1 DPS; differences under 2-3% are within the model's assumptions). These numbers use each spec's own best gear, so they differ a little from the spec pages' ranking, which races every build in the project's standard set per spec. Simulations of the community's model of the beta (with this project's patches; the ElliotWood/Forever fork for searches before 2026-10-18, the official wowsims/forever since; each spec's record names the commit its search ran on), not in-game measurements.

## Gear by spec

Each item opens its Wowhead Forever page (with where it drops: the boss and zone, the profession, the quest or the vendor, when the simulator's item database says) and its enchant; *Open in the simulator* loads the whole character (gear, enchants, talents, rotation, consumables, buffs) in the community's Forever simulator on the web (raidsim/gear_links.py). Relics stay as in the project's standard set. Enchants: the standard set's.
